---
title: "Stephen Stretton"
subtitle: "Climate, Fiscal Policy & Finance"
---

Economist working on climate, fiscal policy, and finance. The research comes in seven sections: carbon pricing in open economies; other tax and fiscal policy; finance and risk for clean power; sovereign incentives for national climate policy; modelling with the Climate Policy Assessment Tool (CPAT); modular upgrades to CPAT; and analytics tools for climate-fiscal work. Most papers come with slides, and those on carbon pricing, finance and risk and sovereign incentives, and the Total Effective Carbon Price, also as a short policy brief.

Three master's degrees in philosophy, economics, and physics. Currently at the World Bank, working on climate policy instruments and country engagements.
